Rina Shah: Quick heads-up 12 SpectrumPay onboarding: we've observed p95 tail ~2.7s on their dedicated pool during evening peak and token spend ~2.5x forecast. Renewal in ~38 days. Proposing a proactive pilot: hybrid int4/int8 model profile with request-complexity routing + small sample of long requests sent to a reserved pool. Need eng, SRE, and enablement to sign off on a 72h canary.

Owen Park: can you drop the perf dash + a representative trace?

Rina Shah: dash: https://redwood.app/d/spectrumpay/ops?panelId=tailing
trace: `req=sp-211 seq=1..896 p50=130ms p95=2.7s model=redwood/aurora-13b`

Owen Park: idea: try `aurora-13b-hybrid4` (int4 for attention, int8 for dense) plus request-complexity routing: seq_len <=512 -> standard pool; seq_len >512 -> sample 15% to dedicated reserved pool. Also enable prefix caching for repeated invoice templates. Should reduce token-equivalent cost ~36% and smooth scheduler load.

Rina Shah: dropping canary snippet. cc @Leila for enablement cadence.

Owen Park: ```
# canary: hybrid int4/int8 profile + complexity-based routing
{"selector": "customer_id == \"spectrumpay\" && sample_rate < 0.15",
 "model_profile": "redwood/aurora-13b-hybrid4",
 "routing": {"rule": "if seq_len > 512 then sample(0.15) -> pool: dedicated-spectrumpay-us-east else use default"},
 "prefix_cache": {"enabled": true, "ttl_minutes": 45},
 "max_concurrency": 70,
 "fallback": "redwood/aurora-13b",
 "monitoring": {"slo_p95_ms": 1400, "compare_baseline": "aurora-13b"},
 "rollback_on": {"p95_increase_pct": 4, "error_rate_increase_pct": 0.2}
}
```

Leila Gomez: I can run a 50-min enablement workshop: 10m infra overview, 20m canary ops, 10m troubleshooting playbook, 10m renewal talking points. Available next Mon/Wed.

Tasha Reed: please capture conservative + optimistic cost deltas for the renewal doc and include success criteria (p95 drop, cost delta, quality parity).

Owen Park: quick estimate: baseline unit ~$0.020/token-eq. hybrid4 path ~36% lower => ~$0.0128/token-eq. For their avg 3.0B tokens/mo that's ~ $33.6k/mo savings optimistic; conservative assume half until validated. Will refine after canary.

MetricsBot: [alert] spectrumpay_prod_avg_seq_len +24% last 48h; token_rate +19%. Created ticket CS-4977.

Rina Shah: linking CS-4977 so SRE/eng can correlate infra metrics and logs. @Evan SRE 12 can you confirm pool headroom and reserve capacity?

Evan SRE: I can reserve a 2-GPU slot on dedicated-spectrumpay-us-east for a 72h canary and add telemetry relabeling. Need IAM list and expected peak rps.

Owen Park: expected steady qps ~180, spikes ~460. IAM: rina@redwood, owen@redwood, leila@redwood. I'll stage smoke tests including a small human review set to validate output quality vs baseline.

Rina Shah: I'll draft a short customer-facing note outlining pilot goals (tail smoothing + cost reduction), rollback criteria, and an exec summary for renewal. Sharing for review before sending.

Tasha Reed: include a one-slide before/after mock for the renewal pack and the conservative savings number. I'll weave the pilot into the renewal timeline.

Leila Gomez: once Evan confirms reservation I'll book the enablement and circulate a short playbook for the customer infra lead.

Evan SRE: reservation pending; will confirm by EOD and post details here.

Rina Shah: thanks all 10 let's aim to kick the canary early next week. I'll update thread when reservation is confirmed :rocket:
_description: Proactive optimization pilot for SpectrumPay: propose hybrid int4/int8 model profile + request-complexity routing and prefix caching; coordinate eng, SRE, enablement; capture cost delta estimate and renewal talking points
